sisi.depan: A massive, segmented warehouse door with interlocking geometric patterns inspired by songket weaving is set into the main grey factory facade, flanked by tall, narrow ventilation slits glowing with a soft amber light.
sisi.kanan: A cluster of slender, polished metal smokestacks with flared tops releasing clean white vapor rises behind a secondary processing building that has a long, horizontal window slit.
sisi.kiri: An enclosed, elevated conveyor bridge supported by thick pillars shaped like stylized bamboo stalks connects a long, windowless factory block to the main building.
sisi.belakang: Behind the camera's position stands a wide security gate made of a dark metallic lattice, set between two low, angular administrative buildings with opaque, dark glass panels.

tengah: In the center of the wide, paved courtyard sit several large, hexagonal cargo containers with smooth, dark grey surfaces, arranged around a central, low-profile atmospheric condenser unit facing towards the main warehouse door.
atas: The sky is a hazy, pale grey, crisscrossed by the faint energy trails of automated cargo transports moving in the far distance.
